title: Great for Travel!
text: Great for Travel!. This Vera Bradley blanket is great for travel! Although thin, it's warm and fuzzy. The size is more than big enough for an adult to use. It comes with a zipper case which makes it easy to take on the go! I have the matching travel pillow and I'm looking forward to my next trip so I can utilize them.

product_metadata.title: Vera Bradley Packable Fleece Blanket
features: FOR HOME & AWAY - Whether it's a long road trip or a chilly morning at home, curl up with something cozy & colorful - This blanket is for every woman looking to keep warm with an added playful pop to her every day
CHIC & COZY - Crafted from fleece, this larger travel blanket comes with its own matching pouch with snap tab for easy transportation - pouch measures 10 inches by 8 inches

STYLISH, LIGHTWEIGHT & SIZED RIGHT - The Vera Bradley Packable Fleece Blanket measures 60 inches high & 45 inches wide, generously sized for spreading out or cuddling close - either way, you'll always want to stay wrapped up in this fleece blanket
MACHINE WASHABLE - This product is built to last, machine washable, & fade resistant to keep you fun & fashionable
description: For restful, relaxing vibes while on the road, bring along the Vera Bradley Packable Fleece Blanket. Soft, lightweight, printed fleece blanket. Includes fleece pouch for storage and travel with zipper closure. 100% Polyester. Machine wash cold, tumble dry.
